market_summary: As the New York cash session approaches its close, broad market conditions across all six instruments are characterized by tight mid-channel consolidation and subdued volume (RVOL < 1.0 across the board). Earlier directional flushes in precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) and BTCUSD have transitioned into horizontal churn just above session lows, with CVD delta slopes flattening out and diverging from the earlier sell-offs. US100 rallied into session close but is encountering stiff overhead resistance at Put Wall #1, VAH, and the Gamma Flip in a negative-amplifying gamma regime. FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) remain paralyzed in micro-ranges around Value Area boundaries. Due to the lack of volume confirmation, late session timing, and proximity to major structural boundaries, all assets warrant a disciplined HOLD.
